aboutHeading: What a weekly visit actually includes
about:
Most pool companies show up, dump chlorine in and leave. That is why your water is cloudy by Thursday.

Every weekly visit is the same list, every time, and it takes about half an hour. You get a photo of the water and the chemistry readings on your phone when we leave, so you know we came and you know where the water stands.

Same technician each week. You will learn their name, and they will learn your equipment.
points: Vacuum the floor, net the surface
Test chlorine, pH, alkalinity, stabiliser and salt
Balance the water — all chemicals included in the price
Check pump, filter pressure, heater and timer
Photo and readings sent to you before we leave
teamLede: The same person every week, and the same person who answers when you call.
ctaLede: Call or text and tell us your pool size and where you are. We will give you a price on the phone — no site visit needed for weekly service.
